name: phpmyadmin/sql-parser
license_evidence: LICENSE.txt in the pinned codeload archive (SHA-256 8177f97513213526df2cf6184d8ff986c675afb514d4e68a404010521b880643, GNU GPL version 2); Packagist license GPL-2.0-or-later
input_api: new PhpMyAdmin\SqlParser\Parser(local SQL text, strict: true) -> statements[]
scope: One SQL statement from local text in strict mode; valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls, each equal to the hand-written oracle summary. Functions are read from select expressions only, because the library stores WHERE conditions as text components.
family: phpMyAdmin sql-parser hand-written lexer and statement parser
family_note: Parser runs its own Lexer (src/Lexer.php) and per-statement parse methods (src/Statements/*, src/Parsers/*) that build Component objects. The adapter reads SelectStatement expr/from/join/where/group/order, InsertStatement into/values, and literal tokens from the parser's TokensList within each statement's first..last token range. Independent of greenlion/php-sql-parser. Debian ships it as phpmyadmin-sql-parser.

popularity.limitation: Lifetime downloads, including installs as a phpMyAdmin dependency.

name: greenlion/php-sql-parser
license_evidence: LICENSE in the pinned codeload archive (SHA-256 686377e26ceb326570edc74459f945d4c4de3a7f36b2bd7f28764a2b72829ac7); Packagist license BSD-3-Clause
input_api: (new PHPSQLParser\PHPSQLParser())->parse(local SQL text) -> clause-keyed array parse tree
scope: One SQL statement from local text; valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls, each equal to the hand-written oracle summary. The parser treats the whole input as one statement.
family: PHP-SQL-Parser lexer and clause processors (nested array parse tree)
family_note: PHPSQLParser::parse runs its own lexer (PHPSQLLexer) and per-clause processors (SelectProcessor, FromProcessor, InsertProcessor, ValuesProcessor, ...) that return a clause-keyed array of expr_type nodes. The adapter walks table, aggregate_function/function, const, column-list and record nodes. Independent of phpMyAdmin sql-parser; soundintheory/php-sql-parser and other Packagist names are forks of this family.

popularity.limitation: Lifetime downloads, including installs as a dependency of other tools.

name: soundintheory/php-sql-parser
license_evidence: BSD 2-Clause text in the header of src/PHPSQL/Parser.php in the pinned codeload archive (file SHA-256 e8d39df1315f5185bf0f22fcc5bf9f2b3d6ad3f74bfba735f2cb4b34b51f4d6e) and composer.json license BSD-2-Clause (SHA-256 0e8e12895f3bb887151ff02562a326d53c0eb1ef3a8454517e1a60ecc2fe4781); the archive has no separate LICENSE file
input_api: (new PHPSQL\Parser())->parse(local SQL text) -> clause-keyed array parse tree
scope: One SQL statement from local text; valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls, each equal to the hand-written oracle summary. The parser treats the whole input as one statement. The 2013 code runs on PHP 8.5 with compile-time warnings, which the harness sends to stderr.
family: PHP-SQL-Parser lineage (2013 PSR-0 fork of the Google Code php-sql-parser; shared family with greenlion/php-sql-parser)
family_note: PHPSQL\Parser::parse runs its own lexer (PHPSQL\Parser\Lexer, Splitter) and one monolithic Parser class (process_select_expr, process_from, process_insert, process_values, ...) that returns a clause-keyed array of expr_type nodes. It is a fork of Justin Swanhart's Google Code project, whose maintained continuation is greenlion/php-sql-parser. The code is not a copy of greenlion v5.0.0: no file is identical after php -w stripping, and only 662 of 1,219 normalized statements (54.3%) also occur in greenlion, which split the parser into per-clause processor classes. Shared family, separate code and package API; Packagist 1.0 is its only release (2013). INSERT targets carry table and columns without an expr_type node, so the adapter reads them from the INSERT entry.

popularity.limitation: Lifetime downloads, including installs as a dependency of other tools.

name: sad_spirit/pg_builder
license_evidence: LICENSE in the pinned codeload archive (SHA-256 851a059de6594af1b622f15db55fba56091f7343a13a430bf13e47ea26b65d78, BSD 2-Clause); Packagist license BSD-2-Clause
dialect: PostgreSQL (the only dialect; default Lexer options)
scope: SQL text from local bytes, cut at ';' tokens from the library's own Lexer because createFromString parses one statement without a terminator; valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls, each equal to the hand-written oracle summary. v3.3.1 is the latest stable release (v3.4.0-beta is a pre-release).
family: pg_builder hand-written PostgreSQL lexer and recursive-descent parser (typed AST)
family_note: pg_builder is a query builder whose core is a full PostgreSQL SQL parser: StatementFactory::createFromString runs sad_spirit\pg_builder\Lexer and Parser (a hand-written recursive-descent port of PostgreSQL's gram.y rules) and returns typed Select/Insert/Update/Delete/Values AST nodes. It parses existing SQL text, so the builder role does not exclude it. The adapter walks the AST with a subclass of the library's BlankWalker. Independent of libpg_query and of the MySQL-oriented phpMyAdmin and PHP-SQL-Parser families.

popularity.limitation: Lifetime downloads, including installs as a dependency of other tools.
